title: Kayak Vacation Rentals Scraper
description: Search Kayak vacation rentals with property names, ratings, amenities, provider prices, and listing links. Batch rental paths and location IDs for future stays.

batch.title: Vacation rental searches
batch.description: KAYAK vacation-rental paths and their location IDs.
batch.valueDescription: Path used to run this search.

schema.description: KAYAK property path copied from a hotel or rental search URL.
KAYAK location identifier for the city, airport, or property search.
Type of KAYAK location identifier, such as a city, airport, or hotel. Accepted values: city.
Hotel check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Hotel check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format, after check-in.
Number of adult travelers included in the search.
Age of one child in the hotel search, from 0 to 17.
Sort order for returned search results. Accepted values: rank_a, price_a, review_a.

relativeDateDefaults.description: When omitted, check-in is set to 30 days from today.
When omitted, check-out is set to two days after check-in.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Search Kayak vacation rentals by location and travel dates. Export rental names, ratings, amenities, provider prices, and links to compare places to stay.
storeCopy.intro: Search Kayak vacation rentals by property path and location ID with names, ratings, amenities, provider prices, and links. Omitted dates default to a future two-night visit.
useCases: Travel planners can compare vacation rental options for a destination.
Rental analysts can track property ratings, amenities, and quoted totals.
Property managers can benchmark public rental inventory by market.
howToUse: Add a KAYAK rental path and matching location ID to each entry in `rentals`.
Set stay dates or use the relative date defaults.
Limit saved listings with `maxResults` and export the property rows.

faqs.question: Where do I find a rental location ID?
faqs.answer: Copy the location code from a KAYAK vacation rental search URL or reuse the ID returned for that market.
